issues.title: Crawl stopped early: page limit
issues.howToFix: Re-run the audit with a higher page limit. If it is already at the maximum, add a robots.txt group for the "OpenSEO-Audit" user agent that disallows sections you don't need audited, such as tag archives or filtered listings, so the limit goes to the pages that matter: https://openseo.so/docs/crawler

issues.title: Duplicate meta description
issues.howToFix: Write a unique meta description per page, or remove the duplicated one entirely — search engines will generate a snippet from page content, which beats a wrong duplicate.

issues.title: Thin content
issues.howToFix: Either expand the page with genuinely useful content, noindex it, or consolidate it into a stronger page. If the content exists but is rendered by JavaScript, ensure it is server-rendered or pre-rendered.
